meta.name: porters-five-forces
meta.description: Read an industry's structure through Porter's Five Forces with documented signals per rating, ending at the profit pool. Use when weighing market entry or when margins erode and nobody can say why.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析行业结构,评估市场进入或利润池变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在进入新市场或利润下滑时系统分析行业竞争格局
copy.tagline_en: Analyze industry structure to evaluate market entry or profit pool shifts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically analyze industry competition when entering a market or facing margin erosion

howto.what: Claude 会按波特五力模型分析指定行业:对竞争对抗、新进入者、替代品、买方、供应商五个力量逐一评级(弱/中/强),每个评级附带带链接的实证信号,并明确评估 AI 驱动的替代。最后指出利润池所在和挤压它的力量,输出固定格式报告。
howto.when: 当你正在权衡是否进入某个市场,或发现利润率持续下滑但谁也说不清原因时触发;也适用于需要用证据而非直觉来评估行业结构的战略讨论。

say.text: 对我们考虑进入的临床数据管理行业做五力分析,决策是进入还是合作。
say.note: Claude 会逐力评级并给出利润池结论。

say.text: CRM 软件利润率一直压缩但原因不明,请给结构性解读。
say.note: 会按五力逐项评级并附证据信号。

say.text: 分析北美中型现场服务管理软件的五力,带地理边界。
say.note: 会只补问未答问题,基于假设继续。

howto.what_en: Runs Five Forces on a named industry: rates each force weak/moderate/strong with cited signals, names AI-driven substitution, closes with the profit pool and what squeezes it. Outputs a fixed schema.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user is weighing market entry or when margins erode without a clear structural explanation; also for strategy debates needing evidence-based force ratings.

say_en.text: Five Forces on clinical data management entry decision: enter or partner?
say_en.note: Claude rates forces and closes on the profit pool.

say_en.text: CRM margins keep compressing with no clear cause; give a structural read.
say_en.note: Rates each force with evidence signals.

say_en.text: NA mid-market field-service software: five forces, geographic limit.
say_en.note: Asks only unanswered questions, proceeds on assumptions.
